traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Francoaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins pinnate or palmate; blades orbicular; stipules absent; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup present or absent; stems herbaceous; flowers in racemes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 4; stamens 4 to 8; carpels 2 to 4. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Francoaceae: its irregular flowers are of no named kind (pea flower, two lips, orchid lip), read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy other. Its flowers are not mostly zygomorphic, so a plant of it states its own symmetry; one that is zygomorphic draws this kind, and one stating none is drawn regular.
